status: Adversarial fixture requirements only; no test execution, measurements or wire adoption

bounds.requirement: At bound clamp movement once; beyond discard the whole sequence through A, then paint X without the movement. Start from row 3 to distinguish.
Five digits valid despite leading zeros; sixth digit enters ignore even though value remains 1; final C is consumed and X paints without movement.

bounds.recipe: CSI followed by 63 semicolons then m gives 64 explicit empty fields; 64 semicolons gives 65.
bounds.requirement: The first resets attributes; the second overflows and changes none, with no extra empty field lost at a cut.
Two intermediates form unsupported ESC; third enters ignore. Neither prints sequence bytes; only X appears.

bounds.recipe: CSI + 509 interleaved NUL bytes + A is exactly 512 bytes; CSI + 510 NUL bytes + A is 513. Follow each with X. Split each stream at every byte, including before its final A; keeper events stay <=512 bytes.
bounds.requirement: NUL is ignored without ending CSI and still counts toward total length. The exact-bound omitted-parameter CUU executes once; the 513-byte sequence overflows on final A, consumes that final without CUU, and X paints normally. Choose initial cursor below row 1 to distinguish the outcomes; prior interleaved controls are never rolled back.
At bound requires capacity admission; out-of-range requests reject before either grid/slot/cut changes. Check arithmetic on oversized imported lengths before allocation.

bounds.recipe: For each OSC/DCS/APC/PM/SOS kind, discard 1 byte and a bounded 65536-byte synthetic payload containing CR/LF/BEL/ESC, ending in the permitted terminator; partition immediately before/after pending ESC.
bounds.requirement: Retain zero payload bytes independent of length; only OSC BEL terminates. No newline screen effects, allocation proportional to payload or nested control dispatch.
Paint A followed by one replacement for U+0301 and one for U+754C, each width one. Do not combine, produce a wide tail or claim Unicode18 conformance.

bounds.recipe: In a 512-byte event, finish one pending DSR query with its final byte, then issue 127 more four-byte DSR queries and pad to the byte cap. Keep dispatch stalled before the next output event.
bounds.requirement: Reserve 128 slots / 4096 bytes before starting the event; stage at most 128 replies and dispatch only after event commit. Pause the next event until prior committed reply capacity is available; never stall mid-event waiting on its own unpublished replies, drop a query, deduplicate or expose partial state.

bounds.recipe: Maximum-size grids; repeated RIS/ED2/scroll and long ignored strings, delivered in <=512-byte keeper events.
bounds.requirement: Yield by 4096 inspected bytes or 4096 charged cells/work items, including copies/snapshots. Staged mutations never leak partial frames; no count-sized loop, geometry/input/reply overtaking or unbounded COW versions. Time/fairness remains unmeasured.

bounds.recipe: Import bounded counters at UINT32_MAX diagnostic saturation and UINT64_MAX next-row/revision allocation, under an otherwise admissible exact tuple.
bounds.requirement: Diagnostic counters saturate and set flags; identity allocation exhaustion is unavailable/unknown and never wraps, including across RIS. No payload log per failure.

forbidden_claims.claim: A live active-grid frame resumes a parser because its cells look correct.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Refuse completeness: inactive buffer, saves/modes/continuation/history/cuts must be explicit.

forbidden_claims.claim: Restore string discard with pending ESC as ground, or omit the pending bit.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Reject incomplete import; do not interpret the remaining backslash/payload as new text or commands.

forbidden_claims.claim: Load under a different engine/profile/Unicode-width-reflow/config policy because a screen hash matches.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Refuse incompatible tuple; no cross-version live migration is adopted.

forbidden_claims.claim: Skip an absent output/resize/options/EOF event and accept the later contiguous-looking screen.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Interpretation remains unknown and all application input, including raw, stays fenced.

forbidden_claims.claim: A capture-only retention gap means an otherwise complete live canonical interpretation is necessarily missing bytes.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Keep evidence/recovery availability distinct from the known live interpretation; no false automatic reset.

forbidden_claims.claim: Restore old terminal state and thereby erase consumed request sequences or retry an uncertain reply/input.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Receipt fences/delivery records remain independent; do not resend; lost receipt identity retires the affected namespace.

forbidden_claims.claim: Publish changed cells/modes from half an event with the previous whole-event frontier or snapshot its private scratch as complete.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Retain the last committed projection or withhold it until the event completes; snapshot only eligible completed-event cuts.

forbidden_claims.claim: Import restores a writer grant or dispatches historical queries because proposed reply IDs are present.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Decode/replay without external effects; reobserve/reconcile and require fresh authority independently.

forbidden_claims.claim: Fixed-event reducer equivalence proves identical shell scheduling, filesystem/network effects or future process output.
forbidden_claims.required_disposition: Reject claim; equivalence covers admitted bounded reduction under a fixed event order and exact semantic tuple only.
